A good example of the proper relationship between IDL values and internal state can be found with `CanvasSetting`'s `colorSpace`: https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-canvas-settings:concept-canvas-color-space-2 and https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/canvas.html#the-canvas-settings:concept-canvas-color-space-3.

I also think this can come after, in a follow-up if you're willing to do it @ccameron-chromium. I don't have strong opinions on the "gargantuan" rewrite you propose, but I do think the narrow refactoring of internal state & attributes is a good one. I'm fine with it happening after this lands though.
